caption: The video captures an elevated view of a broad waterfall where a churning river rushes toward the brink in bands of white foam. Emerald-green sheets of water plunge over the lip, their surface texture and the boundary with the froth shifting constantly. A few low rocky islets and a cluster of dark rocks protrude at the edge, while a long bridge spans the water against a tree-lined, overcast shoreline. Throughout, the rapids keep breaking and reforming along the crest, and the falling curtains maintain a steady cascade. A white mist plume rising from the unseen base grows larger and more prominent, gradually obscuring the lower part of the falling water. The framing drifts slightly, shifting the brink upward to reveal more of the plunge and the swelling spray.
